title: Passkeys
description: Configure the site domain and allowed origins for passkey login

enabled.label: Enable passkey login
enabled.desc: When enabled, users can register passkeys for passwordless login, exempt from two-step verification.

rpId.label: Site domain
rpId.desc: The site domain bound to passkeys (e.g. admin.example.com; use localhost for local debugging). Changing it invalidates all registered passkeys.
rpId.required: Please configure the site domain before enabling
rpId.invalid: Invalid site domain format: enter a plain domain name without protocol or port, e.g. admin.example.com or localhost

rpName.label: Display name
rpName.desc: Site name shown in the system prompt.

origins.label: Origins
origins.desc: Full origins (scheme + domain + port) allowed to use passkeys, e.g. https://admin.example.com. When deploying both admin and merchant apps, add both origins.
origins.placeholder: Type an origin and press Enter
origins.required: Please configure at least one origin before enabling

confirmSaveContent: Save the current configuration? Note: changing the site domain invalidates all registered passkeys.
